author: DJI
description:
The 2026 World Heritage 3D Conservation Initiative is now open.

We're calling on drone mapping pilots, surveyors, and 3D reconstruction specialists worldwide to capture natural and cultural heritage sites, build high-resolution digital twins, and generate immersive flythrough videos using DJI Reality.

What time erodes, you can immortalize.

✅ Two categories: Natural Heritage and Cultural Heritage
✅ Submit by: October 10, 2026

💡Pro Tip: The most compelling videos tell a story. In addition to effectively showcasing your 3D model, you are encouraged to add before/after comparisons, behind-the-scenes workflow footage, shots of your drone at the actual surveying site, and background music. Creativity counts just as much as technical quality.

How to enter on social media:
1. Post your flythrough video to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, or X.
2. Tag  @DJIEnterprise  add #DJIMapYourHeritage and #DJIEnterprise to your caption.

Learn more and download DJI Reality for free 👉 https:/
title: 2026 World Heritage 3D Conservation Initiative | DJI Enterprise
